response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile full-stack/systems engineer with 15+ years of experience and solid production engineering fundamentals, but his background shows no meaningful experience in experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, A/B testing, or growth engineering — the core focus of this role. His career has been generalist (web, mobile, embedded, GIS) rather than specialized in the data/experimentation domain, and there's no evidence of leading multi-team initiatives, statistical analysis, or growth-focused systems at the IC6/Principal scale this role requires.
strengths: Extensive 15+ year engineering career across many languages and domains (C, C++, Java, TypeScript, Node.js)
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, workshops, and open-source project ownership (GISCollective)
Experience with distributed/high-throughput systems (Sociomantic handling millions of requests/sec)
concerns: No demonstrated experience with experimentation platforms, A/B testing, feature flagging, or rollout-risk management
No evidence of telemetry/metrics infrastructure or data-driven growth engineering work
Career trajectory is broad/generalist rather than showing Principal-level cross-team architectural leadership at enterprise scale

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering depth and seniority
